sloka: सीताया सह काकुत्स्थः तस्मिन् घोर मृग आयुते ।ददर्श गिरि शृङ्ग आभम् पुरुषादम् महास्वनम् ॥३-२-४॥
transliteration: sītāyā saha kākutsthaḥ tasmin ghora mṛga āyute ।dadarśa giri śṛṅga ābham puruṣādam mahāsvanam ॥3-2-4॥

translations.english: While Rama along with Sita was wandering in the forest infested with dreadful animals, he saw a roaring cannibal resembling the peak of a mountain.
